name: frappe-dev
description: The mcp-frappe server and a skill for Frappe app development: DocTypes, customizations, site and app sync, with a preview before every write.

frappe_url.title: Site URL
frappe_url.description: Base URL of the development site, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000. HTTPS is required unless the host is loopback or a .localhost name.

frappe_site.title: Site name
frappe_site.description: The site's name on a multi-site Bench, such as site1.localhost (sent as the Host header). Leave empty for a single-site Bench.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key of the Frappe user the server acts as (User > Settings > API Access).

api_secret.title: API secret
api_secret.description: API secret of the same user.

apps_path.title: Bench apps folder
apps_path.description: The Bench's apps folder (absolute path), needed for standard DocTypes, drift checks, and exports. Leave empty to work on the site only.

bench_path.title: Bench folder
bench_path.description: Set it to let the server run migrate, reload-doc, export-fixtures, clear-cache, and run-tests after a preview. Local sites only. Leave empty to keep Bench commands off.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated toolsets: read, data, customize, developer, bench. Empty for all. Next to Frappe's built-in MCP server, use read,customize,developer,bench.
